tools.name: cloudns_list_zones
tools.description: List the DNS zones in the account, or the zones whose name matches a keyword. Paged; reverse zones are included. ClouDNS API: POST /dns/list-zones.json.

tools.name: cloudns_get_zone_info
tools.description: Get one zone: its status, whether it is a master or slave zone, forward or reverse, a cloud domain or a GeoDNS zone. ClouDNS API: POST /dns/get-zone-info.json.

tools.name: cloudns_list_records
tools.description: List the records of a zone, optionally for one host or one record type. host_like matches part of the host and then ignores host. Master zones only. ClouDNS API: POST /dns/records.json.

tools.name: cloudns_add_txt_record
tools.description: Add a TXT record to a master zone. This changes live DNS. Calling it again with the same values adds a duplicate record. ClouDNS API: POST /dns/add-record.json.

tools.name: cloudns_get_failover_settings
tools.description: Get the DNS Failover settings of one record that has DNS Failover & Monitoring active. The API reports Failed when failover is not active on that record. ClouDNS API: POST /dns/failover-settings.json.

tools.name: cloudns_list_monitoring_checks
tools.description: List monitoring checks with their status (up, down or unknown) and state (active or paused). Check types: 17 Ping, 18 Web, 8 TCP, 9 UDP, 10 DNS, 12 Heartbeat, 13 TLS (SSL) certificate, 15 SMTP, 16 Streaming, 19 IMAP, 20 Keyword. ClouDNS API: POST /monitoring/get-records.json.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cloudns_list_zones, cloudns_get_zone_info, cloudns_list_records, cloudns_get_failover_settings, cloudns_list_monitoring_checks · Private data: cloudns_list_records, cloudns_add_txt_record, cloudns_get_failover_settings, cloudns_list_monitoring_checks · Public sink: cloudns_list_zones, cloudns_get_zone_info, cloudns_list_records, cloudns_add_txt_record, cloudns_get_failover_settings, cloudns_list_monitoring_checks.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cloudns_list_zones, cloudns_get_zone_info, cloudns_list_records, cloudns_get_failover_settings, cloudns_list_monitoring_checks · Private data: cloudns_list_records, cloudns_add_txt_record, cloudns_get_failover_settings, cloudns_list_monitoring_checks · Public sink: cloudns_list_zones, cloudns_get_zone_info, cloudns_list_records, cloudns_add_txt_record, cloudns_get_failover_settings, cloudns_list_monitoring_checks

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
